title: Compact diagnostic toasts for rate limits, timeouts, and KV-cache hints
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a set of compact, dismissible diagnostic toast components used in the Quickstart and first-run flows to surface actionable troubleshooting guidance for transient inference failures (rate limits, timeouts, retryable errors) and advisory hints (KV-cache warm, batching suggestions). These toasts must be scannable, accessible, and usable within both the Console and embedded SDK quickstart modals. Goal is to reduce support noise and time-to-recovery for new users hitting limits or degraded performance during onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Three visual variants implemented: Throttle (soft limit), Timeout (retryable), Advisory (info/hint)
Toasts include: short headline (5–7 words), 1-line explanatory copy, 2 CTA options (Primary: Retry/Request Increase, Secondary: Learn More/Ignore)
Color and iconography match console theme and pass 4.5:1 contrast for text on background
Accessible: ARIA live region support, keyboard dismissible, focus returns to invoking element
Responsive: single-line compact layout for narrow viewports, stacked layout for >640px with screenshot thumbnail option
Design tokens exported and a basic CSS snippet and Storybook stories are provided in attachments
Copy variants for PM review: concise, empathetic, and technical (for dev users)
steps: Kickoff: align with PM on signal thresholds that trigger each toast (rate-limit thresholds, downstream timeout durations, KV-cache cold hits)
Create low-fi sketches for three density breakpoints: micro (console toast), mini (embedded quickstart), expanded (help card with screenshot)
Design hi-fi artboards and export tokens + icon set
Add copy variants and get PM + Eng signoff on recommended CTAs
Deliver assets + Storybook entries to frontend for implementation
Design QA: verify spacing, contrast, keyboard/ARIA behavior across browsers and mobile
comments: 2025-02-10 Ava Martinez: Drafting initial brief and sketching micro/mini/expanded variants. Blocking question: what telemetry event should be included for 'Learn More' clicks?
2025-02-12 Rajiv Patel (PM): Use event name onboarding.toast.action and include toast_type + model_variant. Also confirm that rate-limit toast offers 'Request Increase' only for logged-in org admins.

2025-02-13 Maya Chen (Design Assignee): Uploaded low-fi screenshots. Proposed color: amber-60 background + dark text for soft throttles, and indigo-50 for advisory hints. Added microcopy options for technical vs friendly tone.

2025-02-14 Elena Gomez (Engineering): Noted runtime: toasts will be driven by server signal codes 429 / 504 / 408. We can attach a small diagnostic payload (avg latency, batch size, kv_cache_hit:false) to the toast payload for the 'Learn More' panel.

2025-02-16 Product Review (Rajiv): Prefer shorter CTAs. For throttles: Primary = 'Retry now' (simple), Secondary = 'Request increase' (opens billing flow). For timeouts: 'Retry' + 'Adjust timeout'. Added label: customer_impact=medium.

2025-02-18 Design Review (Ava): Updated hi-fi with ARIA guidance. Two follow-ups: 1) create keyboard-only motion spec, 2) add truncated copy fallback when user language is set to long translations. Moving to In Review.
2025-02-18 QA Note (Liam O'Connor): Please include storybook knobs for simulated KV-cache cold/warm states so we can validate messaging correctness in staging.
decisions: Use compact single-line layout by default with expandable indicator for extra context; expanded view includes a tiny 160x90 console screenshot
Three severity tiers handled by same component with tokenized color/icon mapping: advisory/info, recoverable/warning, hard/error
Primary CTA should be deterministic (Retry/Request Increase) and trigger instrumentation event onboarding.toast.action
Toasts will appear for up to 20 seconds by default and be persistent (sticky) when there is an available remedial action (e.g., 'Request Increase')
Include KV-cache hint line when telemetry shows kv_cache_hit:false AND request_length>128 tokens
